messages:
Elena: follow-up from AttrV2 RFC
we need a concrete playbook for promoting extension keys to first-class columns and guaranteeing billing attribution when cost_key is added late. low ceremony please.
Raj: agree. two problems: hotkey cardinality and late enrichment for cost_key. we should pick a deterministic promotion flow + a cheap join sentinel for billing.
Marta: propose promotion flow: collect freq metrics for extension keys (per-org top-100), run weekly scorer (freq, selectivity, queriability) -> promote candidate keys into "hot slots" (slot_id ints). no schema migrations. store strings->id in dictionary service.
Owen: +1. sidecar catalog handles promotions and evictions. rules: min-usage 1k/day, hysteresis 7d, per-org cap 10 slots. promotion is metadata only: row has slot_id fields (slot_1..slot_10) that map to dictionary ids.
Elena: good. about cost attribution: if cost_key arrives in enrichment after sampling, billing can miss it. solution: enrichment emits lightweight sentinel event: cost_claim:{trace_id,cost_key,ts}. store in fast KV (ttl 7d). billing joins by trace_id if envelope lacked cost_key. if claim arrives late mark invoice as "late-claim" and schedule backfill.
Raj: add cost_claim_status enum in CORE: ingress, enrichment, missing, late. useful for dashboards and SLOs.
Marta: ops: extensions stored compressed inline up to 2KB; overflow pointer to object store. also run lightweight PII regexes on top-level extension strings and redact on ingest. log counts per org.
Owen: monitoring: key_promotions (count), promoted_cardinality, billing_match_rate (target 99.5% for committed orgs), cost_claim_latency_p95. alerts when cardinality growth >30% w/w or billing_match_rate drops >0.5%.
Elena: rollout: server-side translation map + client shim, dual-write V1+V2 at 5% for 2w -> 25% for 2w -> 100% with opt-outs. owners: Elena(core+rollout), Raj(dictionary+KV), Marta(SDK+PII), Owen(monitoring). I'll open addendum RFC and tickets.
ingest-bot: created ORG-9999 "AttrV2 key promotion + cost_claim playbook" assigned to Elena, Raj, Marta, Owen. :white_check_mark:
Elena: thanks, will post link to addendum here when ready.
